To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

LSTM networks are able to predict out of sample directional returns for the S&P 100 stocks from 1992 through 2015, that the profitability of LSTM returns is arbitraged away as of 2011, and that LSTM networks exhibit a short term reversal pattern that we are able to exploit in a rules based short reversal strategy.
LSTM networks can outperform a RAF, a DNN, and a LOG for predicting directional movements of financial time series, but that this profitability has largely been arbitraged away by 2010.
LSTM networks are able to outperform memory-free classification models, and that LSTM profitability can be attributed to high volatility stocks that exhibit a short term reversal pattern.
